subject: Final collection workflow & VAT support for SunRidge renewal
messages:
From: ap_team@sunridgehealth.com
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-17T09:14:00-04:00
Subject: Re: SunRidge renewal — final invoice & VAT evidence request

Hi Jordan,

We are preparing the final payment for the renewed Redwood subscription for FY28. Before we can issue the wire, AP needs: 1) final invoice showing the prorated credit applied, 2) Redwood's VAT registration or proof of VAT treatment, and 3) confirmation of the PO number to reference on the invoice.

I've attached our PO for the renewal (SunRidge_PO_210528.pdf). Can you confirm whether Redwood will issue a single final invoice in EUR and include a VAT breakdown?

Thanks,
Clara Mills
Accounts Payable — SunRidge Health
ap_team@sunridgehealth.com
[Attachment: SunRidge_PO_210528.pdf (pdf)]

From: jordan_blake@redwood.com
To: ap_team@sunridgehealth.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2028-05-18T11:02:00-04:00
Subject: Re: SunRidge renewal — final invoice & VAT evidence request

Hi Clara — thanks for the PO and the clear list. We can do a single EUR invoice. A couple quick clarifications before we finalize:

- Is SunRidge requesting a split wire (deposit + final balance) or a single settlement?
- Please confirm the exact legal entity name and TIN you want on the invoice (we need this for tax records).

I'm looping in Vanessa (billing) and Vivek (collections) to coordinate the wire instructions and to attach the settlement playbook so you can see the proposed breakdown.

Attach: Redwood_settlement_playbook_v1.pdf (playbook shows credit schedule, expected invoice lines, and suggested payment timeline).

Plan: once we have TIN + PO confirmation we'll issue the formal invoice and send the DocuSign amendment for the end-of-term true-up (one-step signature to accept final amounts). Proposed wire date: 2028-05-30. If that works, we'll lock the invoice and send copies to AP and Treasury.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Renewals
Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
[Attachment: Redwood_settlement_playbook_v1.pdf (pdf)]

Clara / Jordan — confirming from Billing: we validated the PO and can issue a single final invoice referencing PO# SR-2028-0528. Wire instructions below (SEPA preferred):

Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
IBAN: GB99REDD00000000012345
BIC/SWIFT: REDWGB2L
Reference: HS-2028-0934 / SR-2028-0528

VAT treatment: our records show Redwood is not VAT-registered in the EU for this entity; for cross-border services SunRidge may be able to apply reverse-charge. We will include a VAT breakdown and a line referencing the reverse-charge note. Please confirm whether SunRidge prefers the VAT line to show 0% with a reference note, or for us to provide a VAT-exempt certificate.

I have attached the PO we received and a draft amendment to be signed via DocuSign (DocuSign link will be sent once Clara confirms the TIN).

Attachments: SunRidge_PO_210528.pdf
Related hubspot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HS-2028-0934

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Billing Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Final: invoice & wire plan for HS-2028-0934

Clara / SunRidge AP — summary and next steps (final):

1) Invoice: Redwood will issue one final EUR invoice titled "Redwood Final Invoice — HS-2028-0934" referencing PO SR-2028-0528 and SunRidge TIN US-45-889-1123. The invoice will include:
   - Line items: FY28 renewal fee, credit/true-up line (prorated amount), and administrative fee (if applicable).
   - VAT line: 0% VAT with "reverse-charge — customer liable" note.

2) Attachments: you will receive the final invoice (Redwood_Final_Invoice_HS-2028-0934.pdf) and the credit schedule (Credit_schedule_HS-2028-0934.xlsx) immediately after the DocuSign amendment is completed.

3) DocuSign: we've created the amendment for signature. Link: https://docusign.com/remlink/ABCD1234

4) Wire: please route the SEPA wire on 2028-05-30 to the IBAN provided earlier and use reference HS-2028-0934 / SR-2028-0528. If the payment is sent earlier, please notify Vivek so we can reconcile.

5) Records: Rafael (billing ops) will upload the final invoice and the payment evidence to the HubSpot deal record after reconciliation. HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HS-2028-0934

If this captures everything, please reply with an "ACK" and we'll trigger the DocuSign and invoice issuance.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Renewals
Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
